turns.user: Show me published prints similar to an 800 mm high wall printed with a 25 mm nozzle and 15 mm layers.
turns.text:
I’ll search the print-run literature database for analogues matching the wall height, nozzle width, and layer height, then report the closest published cases and how closely each matches.
The analogue tool requires a layer cycle time or wall path length even though neither affects the three dimensions you specified. I’ll query the print-run database directly so I can rank matches without inventing an operating parameter.
No published run matched all three dimensions exactly. The closest documented wall prints are:

| Publication | Nozzle | Layer | Height achieved | Outcome |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|
| [Cleaner Materials (2022)](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.clema.2022.100090), RBA-3DPC Mix 2 | 25 mm | 15 mm | 390 mm, 26 layers | Printable; 60 mm/s, 84 s/layer |
| [Journal of Cleaner Production (2023)](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jclepro.2023.136247), RBA-3DPC and PCM-3DPC | 25 mm | 15 mm | 390 mm, 26 layers | Both printable; 60 mm/s |
| [Construction and Building Materials (2025)](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.conbuildmat.2025.141735), H-3 | 20 mm | 10 mm | 730 mm, 66 layers | Reached 730 mm before plastic collapse |
| [Cement and Concrete Composites (2022)](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cemconcomp.2022.104424), L30-LWA | 20 mm | 15 mm | 465 mm | Elastic buckling |
| [Journal of Building Engineering (2020)](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jobe.2020.101779), 3DP mortar | 30 mm | 15 mm | 460 mm | Plastic collapse; borderline evidence |

The strongest process analogue is the 390 mm façade print because its 25 mm nozzle and 15 mm layers match exactly. The 730 mm H-3 wall is the closest height analogue, but it used smaller extrusion dimensions and ultimately collapsed. Therefore, these studies do not by themselves validate stable construction to 800 mm.

input.sql:
WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT
      r.paper_uid,
      r.run_id,
      r.mix_name_in_paper,
      r.object,
      CAST(r.layer_height_mm AS REAL) AS layer_height_mm,
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF(CAST(r.nozzle_d_mm AS REAL),0),
        NULLIF(CAST(p.nozzle_d_mm AS REAL),0),
        NULLIF(CAST(r.nozzle_w_mm AS REAL),0),
        NULLIF(CAST(p.nozzle_w_mm AS REAL),0)
      ) AS nozzle_mm,
      COALESCE(
        NULLIF(CAST(r.height_achieved_mm AS REAL),0),
        NULLIF(CAST(r.n_layers_achieved AS REAL),0) * NULLIF(CAST(r.layer_height_mm AS REAL),0)
      ) AS achieved_height_mm,
      CAST(r.n_layers_achieved AS REAL) AS n_layers_achieved,
      CAST(r.print_speed_mm_s AS REAL) AS print_speed_mm_s,
      CAST(r.layer_cycle_time_s AS REAL) AS layer_cycle_time_s,
      r.outcome,
      r.failure_mode,
      r.printability_label,
      r.label_basis,
      r.confidence,
      r.source_locator,
      r.quote
    FROM print_runs r
    LEFT JOIN printers p ON p.paper_uid = r.paper_uid
    WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(r.object,'')) LIKE '%wall%'
  )
  SELECT *,
    ROUND(
      ABS(achieved_height_mm - 800.0)/800.0 +
      ABS(nozzle_mm - 25.0)/25.0 +
      ABS(layer_height_mm - 15.0)/15.0
    , 4) AS distance_score
  FROM candidates
  WHERE achieved_height_mm IS NOT NULL
    AND nozzle_mm IS NOT NULL
    AND layer_height_mm IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY distance_score ASC
  LIMIT 12

WITH candidates AS (
    SELECT r.paper_uid, r.run_id, r.mix_name_in_paper, r.object,
      CAST(r.layer_height_mm AS REAL) AS layer_height_mm,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(r.nozzle_d_mm AS REAL),0),NULLIF(CAST(p.nozzle_d_mm AS REAL),0),
               NULLIF(CAST(r.nozzle_w_mm AS REAL),0),NULLIF(CAST(p.nozzle_w_mm AS REAL),0)) AS nozzle_mm,
      COALESCE(NULLIF(CAST(r.height_achieved_mm AS REAL),0),
               NULLIF(CAST(r.n_layers_achieved AS REAL),0)*NULLIF(CAST(r.layer_height_mm AS REAL),0)) AS achieved_height_mm,
      CAST(r.n_layers_achieved AS REAL) AS n_layers_achieved,
      CAST(r.print_speed_mm_s AS REAL) AS speed_mm_s,
      CAST(r.layer_cycle_time_s AS REAL) AS cycle_s,
      r.outcome, r.failure_mode, r.printability_label, r.label_basis, r.confidence, r.source_locator
    FROM print_runs r LEFT JOIN printers p ON p.paper_uid=r.paper_uid
    WHERE LOWER(COALESCE(r.object,'')) LIKE '%wall%'
  )
  SELECT *,
    ROUND(ABS(achieved_height_mm-800.0)/800.0 + ABS(nozzle_mm-25.0)/25.0 +
          ABS(layer_height_mm-15.0)/15.0,4) AS distance_score
  FROM candidates
  WHERE achieved_height_mm IS NOT NULL AND nozzle_mm IS NOT NULL AND layer_height_mm IS NOT NULL
  ORDER BY distance_score, paper_uid, run_id
  LIMIT 10
